parts.name: Cap
parts.Basic_description: This is the cap of a pen, made of plastic, typically cylindrical with a clip for attachment. It covers the pen tip to prevent ink from drying.
parts.Functional_description: The cap protects the pen tip and prevents ink leakage or drying. It can also clip onto pockets or notebooks for portability.
parts.Movement_description: It can be removed or attached to the pen body by pulling or pushing, sometimes with a snap fit.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the main body of the pen, made of plastic, cylindrical in shape, and houses the ink reservoir and writing tip.
parts.Functional_description: The base body provides structure, holds the ink cartridge, and serves as the main gripping area for writing.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary during use, except for the writing motion controlled by the user’s hand.
